entries.653f1dedd00415fb: This segment manufactures and sells epoxy resins, polyurethane raw materials, water-based resins, surfactants, lubricant additives, kitchen cleaning agents, cosmetic ingredients, propylene glycols, hydrogen peroxide and derivatives, water-swellable sealing materials, battery materials and other products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue and profit increased, and revenue rose 1.8% from the previous fiscal year. In Asia and the United States, lubricant additives for automobile engine oil and specialty epoxy resins for electronic components performed well. Photocurable resins for displays were solid, and reactive emulsifiers, whose uses expanded to adhesives and other applications despite the impact of the slump in construction demand in China, were also solid. Effective April 1, 2025, electronics-related materials that had been included in the former "Electronic Materials" were included in this segment.
entries.6db55dd60bd8cc1c: Plant Design, Construction Management and Equipment Maintenance
entries.788b748a5b40aef3: This business manufactures and sells margarines, shortening, fats and oils for chocolate, fats and oils for frying and cooking, plant-based foods, whipped cream, cream for kneading into dough, fillings, mayonnaise and dressings, functional food ingredients and other products. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥83,003 million (up 0.6% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for 19.9% of consolidated revenue, and revenue increased and profit decreased. In Japan, sales of high-function kneading ingredients that contribute to reducing food production losses and of the "Deli Plants" series, centered on plant-based cheese, were solid. In China, where the economic slump continues, sales of shortening and margarines used in bread and confectionery were weak.
entries.79c77192bd0542ea: This business manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, veterinary drugs, wood preservatives, medical materials and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥111,797 million (up 11.8% year on year), equivalent to 26.8% of consolidated revenue, and both revenue and profit increased. The 'Business Description' section of the securities report lists Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd. first among its principal affiliates; it is a consolidated subsidiary in which the company holds 51.00% of the voting rights. During the period, herbicides for fruit trees and potatoes performed well in Europe, and insecticides for fruit trees and nuts also performed well in the United States. In Japan, rising rice prices boosted farmers' production motivation and increased the planted area of paddy rice, so herbicides and insecticides for paddy rice and others performed well.

Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last in the list, not because of its small revenue.

entries.b2ef327b7df0c3bc: This segment manufactures and sells high-purity semiconductor materials, photoacid generators and other products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased and profit decreased, and revenue rose 5.8% from the previous fiscal year. With the expanding introduction of EUV exposure equipment and growing demand for PFAS-free products, semiconductor lithography materials for advanced photoresists performed well. With shipments of new products supporting the start of production of the latest-generation DRAM, sales of high-dielectric materials turned to an expanding trend from the third quarter and were solid for the full year. Fixed-cost burdens increased due to upfront investments such as additional staff in research and development and the construction of new production plants. The name of this segment was changed from "Electronic Materials" effective April 1, 2025.
entries.b370f108567dd5cb: A business that manufactures and sells a wide range of chemical products, divided into three areas: resin additives, semiconductor materials, and environmental materials. It is the reportable segment with the largest net sales in the Group. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥214,810 million (down 1.7% from the previous year), accounting for 51.6% of consolidated net sales of ¥416,563 million, with decreases in both sales and profit. The "Business Overview" section of the securities report states that this business is "broadly classified into three types of products." As of April 1, 2025, the sub-segment "Electronic Materials" was renamed "Semiconductor Materials," and the electronics-related materials that had been included in "Electronic Materials" were included in "Environmental Materials." The securities report compares the previous fiscal year's results after reclassifying them into the revised categories.

entries.c4914f875a75769b: This segment manufactures and sells additives for polyolefins, stabilizers and plasticizers for PVC, flame retardants and other products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue and profit decreased, and revenue fell 6.7% from the previous fiscal year. With the slump in the home appliance and EV markets continuing, and with intensifying price competition, sales of flame retardants were weak, mainly in Europe and the United States. Production slowed in the petrochemical market, and sales of antioxidants, which are used in plastic products in general, were also weak. On the other hand, against the background of expanding investment in data centers, PVC stabilizers for electric wires performed well.
